title: 第21章
content:
距离小夜出生大约三百年前，在一片宇宙空间，一艘巨大的灵舰飞速的在空间穿梭，舰身上刻满了符文，符文明暗闪烁，流光溢彩，驶向末央星域。舰仓内，一位白袍儒生背对门外，正在向案前一位老者说话。“三叔，您老去歇一会，还有六十年左右就到末央星域了，快到的时候，我去叫您，这舰上，我安排弟子们盯着，我亲自坐镇舰首指挥”“嗯，不急，等你九叔和你六姑出关后，我再去休息，不亲自盯着，我不放心啊，前方就快到小陨石漂流带了，还有杂乱无章小彗星，这一片空间出没几支星际大盗，情况复杂，我有不好的预感，船舰上许些杂物不值几个钱，关键是天机匣，一定要安全送到末央星域，亲手交给十四祖手里，这可是老祖亲自再三交代的，如果有什么不测，你和你六姑带上天机匣，坐上小灵舰，啥也不要管，直接去末央星域，明白吗？”案前一灰衣老者盘膝而坐，怀里窝着一只黑猫。白衣儒生一楞，笑道“没那么严重吧，我们这可是玄玉号跨星舰，攻防一体，就是太乙期仙君来了，也能周旋一二，再说不是还有你们三位吗？如果真的有意外，请您老放心！我誓死扞卫我们家族的尊严，决不逃跑！”“糊涂！家族的目的是什么？是天机匣！此物万万不可丢失，这关系到我们家族能不能在末央星域打开局面，能不能站稳脚跟，你十四祖眼巴巴等着呢！”老者一瞪眼。“三叔，我知道轻重缓急，到时候如果有意外我一切听您安排，叔，这天机匣里装的是什么啊？老祖这么重视，”灰衣老者看了他一眼，沉思片刻，低声道“两个小世界，空间很大，里面的资源能让大罗金仙垂涎三尺”白衣男子一惊，“什么，不是只有一个小世界吗，另外一个小世界那来的？老祖咋考虑的？”老者叹口气道“一个是我们家的，另外一个是我们十万多年前豪夺崔家的，老祖亲自出的手，这事过后许多人有猜测是我们干的，现在十万年过去了，渐渐淡忘了，我们才拿出来，准备送到末央星域，此物我们家族打不开，老祖研究了几万年，如若强行打开，此物自毁。前一段时间，你十四祖传来消息，说是抓了个崔家后人，可以利用其精血能打开这小世界，老祖才让咱们送过去，老祖怀疑这个小世界里有本源之物，而且比我们的那个小世界还大。此事你知道就行，别往底下传了，知道的人越少越好。此事终了，你就别回宁合星域了，就在十四祖麾下修行，帮你十四祖处理一些俗事，十四祖非常看好你，亲自点了你名，否则，家祖里那么多精英，哪里能轮到你头上”白衣男子沉默了半响道“哪个崔家？是环玙星域微尘大陆的那个崔家吗？”“不是他们，还有谁？在道祖的品茶大会上，处处和我们陈家过不去，崔家老祖事事压我们老祖一头”老者恶狠狠的说道“也是他们崔家走霉运，他家老祖冲击大罗，没成功，身死道消，下面几脉旁系不服现任族长，接着数十位老怪份份出关，争权夺利，大打出手，死伤无数，血流成河，更有甚者是勾结外人，搞得族内乌烟瘴气。有一脉气愤不过，就偷偷地在内库里取出小世界，带上几名亲信，准备离开微尘大陆去其他界面发展，嘿嘿，结果，中了咱们老祖的圈套，老祖一个不留全部杀死了，当时十四祖也在场。得到了小世界，两位老祖开心的合不上嘴，直接隐身而去，辗转了几个星域才回来，就这都有不少有心人怀疑上咱们…”就在一老一少在仙舰上交谈时，远方的一块巨大陨石内部盘坐着三个人，一女两男，女修手里拿着一面镜子，镜面反射出的正是陈家玄玉号跨星舰。两男修其中有一个鬼修脸色蜡白，浑身上下时不时散出一缕黑色的尸气。“我敢确定舰上没有太乙金仙，我的三冥玄煞气在附近没有感应到大波动，也觉察不到太乙的气息，这一票，能干！金花仙子你就不能让小陨石群偏离一点轨道，让邱道友利用陨石布阵，困住舰船，我们也好从容动手”鬼修看着金花仙子手里的镜面问道。女修金花仙子看瞪了他一眼道“哪有那么容易，离空挪移镜只能搬动固定的物体，数量还不会太多，小陨石群可是高速移动的，要不，你试试？”鬼修嘿嘿一笑，转头道“邱英老哥，你说道说道”那名叫邱英的老头没理会二人，手里摆弄着几面小旗，半响说道“不急，前方数百万里位置有一群陨石带，旁边万里的地方是他们必经之路，他们绝对不会绕路，否则会被下方的巨大太阴星体引力拉过去，他们不敢赌。在过个三五天，我去哪里部阵，金花仙子你拿离空挪移镜提前在前面拉动一部分小陨石，我们也要注意，别被太阴星拉跑，嘿嘿，否则百余年都走不出来，我先走一步，三天后等我传讯”三天后，金花仙子也接到传讯走了，去挪移陨石了，就剩下鬼修不动声色的放出三冥玄煞气时时的感应着陈家灵舰，宇宙里没有空气，无法传播，全凭鬼修的玄煞气追踪感应。此门功法也简单，就是先释放一丝三冥玄煞气在舰船的必经之路上，随后本人在万里之外隐藏起来不停的释放玄煞气相互感应，问题是别人来不了，只有这鬼修的尸气变异之后炼成。鬼修不停的给二人传讯，金花仙子累的要死，不时的咽下丹丸恢复元气。“好了，静等上钩”邱老怪给二人传讯。远处的舰船上，白衣人正在安排。“各弟子注意，到自己岗位上去，各负其责，马上通过陨石群”舰船上白衣男子立在甲板上，大声呵斥着。陈家另外两个老怪也出关了，和白衣男修的三叔站在舰塔上，三人面色凝重。大船不停的扭动着身子，快速穿越陨石群。突然，两颗大陨石像见了鬼一般脱离轨道，闪电一般的砸向大船，舰体发出几道蓝光，船身摇晃着，舰上一阵惊叫，还好，陨石被击碎，危险解除。接下来半个月，总有陨石不停的砸向舰船，船上众人疲惫不堪，船上能量消耗严重，船身也有几处破碎。舰塔上三人都觉得蹊跷。“不对，退回去！”三叔道。刚要传令，四面八方冒出来七七四十九个巨大陨石，众多陨石之上绿光一闪，形成一个巨大黑洞吞噬大船。“好胆”“有贼人”“有埋伏”……舰上三人大惊，飞出舰塔各使手段打向陨石。

“桀桀，拿命来吧”星空中，一阵狂笑，一老者像个巨大的蝙蝠冲向三人。“杀”黑暗的空间，又有三颗陨石砸向舰船，前方阵旗形成的黑洞拼命地撕扯着大船，舰船剧烈的跳动，发出嘎嘎的巨响。“哄”的一声，陨石砸到了舰尾，鬼修化作一团黑雾乘机而入，船上发出一阵惨叫声。“轰隆隆”一声，舰身炸裂，火光冲天。“六妹，你和毅儿带上东西，快走！我和老九断后”打斗声、爆炸声、碰撞声乱成一团，虚空都扭曲了。数万里之外，一条巨蛇被火光干扰，它数千年前被太阴星引力无意拉到这里，昏昏沉沉的沉睡，它没被惊醒，它无意识的、无目标尾巴一摆向这片打斗区域扫来，顿时，星空撕裂，数万里的长尾像一道闪电甩了过来，空中留下一片残影。“不”“天哪”“是烛九阴”“跑啊”片刻后，万里区域静悄悄，什么都没有了，只有一个二尺长，半尺宽的匣子向闪电一般，拉着火光，飞往黑暗的太空，不知所终，怪蛇又盘成一团。与此同时，遥远的宁合星域陈家祖地安放着魂牌殿堂，一阵噼里啪啦，几百个魂牌破碎，其中有三个是老祖级别的，看守命魂殿的弟子大吃一惊，头发都炸起来了，两腿直哆嗦，觉得小腿肚子都扭到前面去了，他连滚带爬出了门直奔族长洞府。陈族长坐在案几前，在看账本，满脸都是笑容，嘿嘿！收成不错嘛！听见有弟子叩门，叫进来问道“慌慌张张，成何体统！”弟子结结巴巴说道“有几百个族人全部身亡，其中包括三位叔祖”。老族长听的心惊肉跳，刚要起身只觉得两眼一黑，“扑通”又坐在榻上。少许又挣扎起来，跟随后辈弟子来到命魂殿，看的两眼直发呆。“完了，全完了，怎么给老祖交代啊！三叔祖他们全死了，东西肯定丢了。”族长一闪身，来到传送殿，昏昏沉沉的踏进传送阵去往老祖宗闭关的洞府，他在门口站立片刻，斟酌了一下词语，发出传音符后就肃穆而立。一个多时辰后，里面传来沙哑的声音“进来吧”族长进去后“扑通”一下跪在老祖面前，然后一五一十的告诉老族。老祖听罢两眼如电，紧紧的盯着族长说道“你怎么看，有怀疑对象吗？”“这么大的事，我哪里敢给下面说，就我们两人知道”。“会是谁呢？据你刚才的描述，命魂牌都是同一瞬间破碎，证明他们都是死在刹那间，能够如此之快的杀人起码是太乙修士或者是大罗”老祖说道。族长霍的一抬头道“十四爷？”老祖不动神色，半响，摇摇头道“不是他，东西本来就是给他送去的，迟早他要用到，再说，他早年跟人争斗，留下了暗疾，此生无望大罗，那东西对他用处不大，还有，毅儿是他最看好的后辈，他对毅儿疼爱有加，他下不去手，所以绝不是他！你给老十四发个夸星域传讯符，让他查查，东西一定要找回来，你下去吧”族长告退，着手办理此事。七十年后，陈家十四爷和几个属下来到这片空域，没有惊动烛九阴，默默无语，半柱香时间过后，陈家十四祖心中暗道“天机匣以艮玄轻铁锻造而成，轻如鸿毛，坚硬无比，万物不侵，绝对没有毁掉，肯定是落往某片星域，找！不惜一切代价，一定要找到，问题是七十年过去了，它飞到哪里了？它向哪个方位飞去了？欣慰的是他人得到，没我陈家独特手法，他也打不开，还有机会。”“走，不回末央星域了，直接回宁合星域祖地”十四祖一跺脚说道。天机匣以闪电的速度，飞向深空，中途不时的碰撞小天体、小陨石，不停地变换着方向，飞行了七十年后。天机匣好巧不巧的方位对准小夜家乡裂尘大陆，拉着火光飞奔而来。
content_en:
About three hundred years before Xiao Ye was born, in a cosmic space, a huge spiritual ship shuttled rapidly through the space. The ship's body was covered with runes. The runes flickered darkly and brilliantly, and it sailed towards the Moyang Star Territory.In the ship's cabin, a white-robed Confucian scholar faced away from the door and was talking to an old man in front of the case."Third uncle, please go and rest for a while. We will reach the Moyang Star Territory in about sixty years. When we are about to arrive, I will call you. I will arrange for my disciples to keep an eye on this ship, and I will personally sit on the bow and command." "Well, don't worry, I will rest after your ninth uncle and your sixth aunt are out of seclusion. I don't worry if I don't keep an eye on it myself. There is a small meteorite drift zone ahead, and there are also scattered small comets. There are several interstellar thieves in this space.The situation is complicated, and I have a bad feeling. Some of the debris on the ship are not worth much. The key is the Tianji box, which must be safely delivered to the Moyang Star Territory and handed over to the Fourteenth Ancestor. This is what the ancestor has personally told repeatedly. If anything happens, you and your sixth aunt will take the Tianji box and get on the small spirit ship. Don't worry about anything and go directly to the Moyang Star Territory.Do you understand?" In front of the case, an old man in gray clothes sat cross-legged, with a black cat nestled in his arms.The scholar in white was stunned and said with a smile, "It's not that serious. We are the Xuanyu interstellar ship, integrating offense and defense. Even if the Immortal Lord Taiyi comes, we can still deal with it. Besides, aren't there the three of you? If there is an accident, please don't worry! I will defend our family to the death.The dignity of the family, never run away!" "Confused!What is the purpose of the family?It is the Tianji Box!This thing must not be lost. It is related to whether our family can open up a situation in the Moyang Star Territory and whether it can gain a foothold.You, the Fourteenth Ancestor, are waiting eagerly!""Third uncle, I know the priorities. If there is an accident, I will follow your arrangements. Uncle, what is in the casing today? Ancestor attaches so much importance to it." The old man in gray glanced at him, pondered for a moment, and whispered, "Two small worlds, a lot of space, and the resources inside can make Daluo Jinxian salivate." The man in white saidSurprised, "What, isn't there only one small world? Where did the other small world come from? What did ancestor think about it?" The old man sighed and said, "One is from our family, and the other is from our family that robbed the Cui family more than 100,000 years ago. The ancestor personally did it. After this incident, many people speculated that it was us. Now that 100,000 years have passed,After gradually forgetting it, we took it out and prepared to send it to the Moyang Star Territory. Our family cannot open this thing. Our ancestor has studied it for tens of thousands of years. If it is opened by force, this thing will self-destruct.Some time ago, your fourteenth ancestor sent news that he had captured a descendant of the Cui family and could use his blood to open this small world. The ancestor only let us send it.Go, Ancestor suspects that there is something of origin in this small world, and it is bigger than ours.Just know this, and don’t spread it to others. The fewer people know about it, the better.Once this matter is over, don’t go back to the Ninghe Star Territory. Just practice under the Fourteenth Patriarch and help you with some mundane matters. The Fourteenth Patriarch is very optimistic about you.I called your name personally, otherwise, there are so many elites in the family, how can it be your turn?" The man in white was silent for a long time and said, "Which Cui family?Is it the Cui family in the Huanxing Star Territory and Dust Continent?" "If it wasn't them, who else?At Daozu's tea tasting party, the ancestors of the Cui family were always in trouble with us."Ancestor," the old man said fiercely, "it was also the Cui family that was unlucky. His ancestor attacked Daluo but failed and died. Several of the subordinate clans disobeyed the current clan leader. Then dozens of old monsters came out and fought for power and profit. There were countless casualties and rivers of blood. Some even colluded with outsiders and caused trouble within the clan.Yan Miasma.One lineage was angry, so he secretly took out the small world from the inner treasury, took a few cronies with him, and prepared to leave the Dust Continent to develop in other interfaces. Hey, in the end, he fell into the trap of our ancestors, and killed them all.The fourteenth ancestor was also present at the time, and the two ancestors were very happy.He spoke up, disappeared directly, and traveled around several star fields before coming back. There are many people who are suspicious of us..." Just as an old man and a young man were talking on the fairy ship, three people, one woman and two men, were sitting cross-legged inside a huge meteorite in the distance. The female cultivator was holding a mirror in her hand, and what was reflected in the mirror was the Chen Family Xuanyu cross-star ship.One of the two male cultivators, a ghost cultivator, had a pale face, and a black corpse aura emitted from his body from time to time."I'm sure there is no Taiyi Golden Fairy on the ship. My Sanmingxuan evil spirit did not sense big fluctuations nearby, and I cannot detect Taiyi's aura. This vote is great! Golden Flower Fairy, can't you let the small meteorite group deviate a little from the orbit and let Qiu Daoyou use the meteorites to form an array to trap the ship, so we can take action calmly." Ghost Cultivator asked, looking at the mirror in Golden Flower Fairy's hand.The female cultivator Golden Flower Fairy glared at him and said, "How can it be that easy? The air moving mirror can only move fixed objects, and the number is not too many. The small meteorites move at high speed. How about you try?" The ghost cultivator chuckled, turned around and said, "Brother Qiu Ying, what are you talking about?"The old man named Qiu Ying ignored the two of them, fidgeting with a few small flags in his hand, and said after a while, "Don't worry, there is a group of meteorite belts millions of miles ahead, and the place thousands of miles away is the path they must pass. They will never take a detour, otherwise they will be hit by the huge lunar star below.They don't dare to bet that gravity will pull them over.In three to five days, where will I go to form the formation? Fairy Jinhua, use the air-moving mirror to pull some small meteorites in advance. We must also be careful not to be pulled away by the lunar star. Hehe, otherwise we will not be able to get out for more than a hundred years. I will take the first step."Wait for my summons in three days." Three days later, Fairy Jinhua also received the summons and left to move the meteorite. The ghost cultivator was left to quietly release the three mysterious evil spirits to sense the Chen family's spirit ship. There is no air in the universe and cannot be transmitted. It all depends on the ghost cultivator's mysterious evil energy to track and sense.This technique is also simple. It is to first release a trace of the mysterious evil energy of the Three Underworlds on the only way the ship must pass. Then, I hide myself thousands of miles away and continuously release the evil evil energy to interact with each other. The problem is that no one else can come. Only the corpse energy of this ghost cultivator is mutated and refined.The ghost cultivator kept sending messages to the two of them. The Golden Flower Fairy was so tired that she swallowed pills from time to time to regain her strength."Okay, wait for the bait." Old Monster Qiu summoned the two of them.On the ship in the distance, the man in white is making arrangements."Attention, disciples, go to your posts, each assume your own responsibilities, and pass through the meteorites immediately." The man in white on the ship stood on the deck and yelled loudly.Two other old monsters from the Chen family also came out of seclusion. They were standing on the ship tower with their third uncle, a male cultivator in white, with solemn expressions on their faces.The big ship kept twisting and turning, quickly passing through the meteorites.Suddenly, two large meteorites derailed as if they had seen a ghost, and struck the ship like lightning. The ship's hull emitted several blue lights, and the ship shook. There was a scream on the ship. Fortunately, the meteorites were shattered, and the danger was relieved.In the next half month, meteorites kept hitting the ship. Everyone on the ship was exhausted, the energy consumption on the ship was serious, and the ship's hull was broken in several places.The three people on the ship tower felt strange."No, go back!" said the third uncle.Just as he was about to give the order, seven or forty-nine huge meteorites appeared from all directions. Green light flashed above the many meteorites, forming a huge black hole that swallowed the ship."How brave", "there is a thief", "there is an ambush"... The three people on the ship were shocked and flew out of the ship tower to hit the meteorite with various means.

"Jie Jie, take your life." There was a burst of laughter in the starry sky, and an old man rushed towards the three of them like a huge bat."Killing" the dark space, three more meteorites hit the ship. The black hole formed by the flag in front tore at the ship desperately. The ship beat violently and made a loud rattling sound.With a "coaxing" sound, the meteorite hit the stern of the ship. The ghost cultivator turned into a black mist and took the opportunity to enter, and there was a scream on the ship.With a "rumbling" sound, the hull of the ship exploded and flames shot into the sky."Liu Mei, you and Yi'er bring your things and leave quickly! Lao Jiu and I are separated." The sound of fighting, explosions, and collisions became a mess, and the void was distorted.Tens of thousands of miles away, a giant snake was disturbed by the fire. It was accidentally pulled here by the gravity of the moon thousands of years ago. It fell into a deep sleep. It was not awakened. Its unconscious and aimless tail swung towards the fighting area. Suddenly, the starry sky was torn. The long tail tens of thousands of miles away was like a bolt of lightning, leaving an afterimage in the sky."No" "Oh my God" "It's Zhu Jiuyin" "Run" After a moment, the Wanli area was quiet and there was nothing left. There was only a box two feet long and half a foot wide. It was like lightning. It pulled the fire and flew into the dark space. It didn't know where it ended up, and the strange snakes coiled up again.At the same time, in the distant Ninghe Star Territory, the Soul Tablet Hall where the Chen family's ancestral land was placed, there was a burst of crackling, and hundreds of soul tablets were shattered, three of which were at the ancestor level. The disciple guarding the Soul Tablet was shocked, his hair was blowing up, his legs were shaking, and he felt that his calves were twisted to the front. He rolled out of the door and went straight to the clan leader's cave.Patriarch Chen is sitting in front of the desk, looking at the account books, with a smile on his face, hehe!What a good harvest!Hearing a disciple knock on the door, he called in and asked, "How can you be so panicked?" The disciple stammered and said, "Hundreds of clan members are all dead, including three uncles."The old patriarch was frightened when he heard this. Just as he was about to get up, his eyes darkened and he sat down on the couch again.Shao Xu struggled again and followed the younger disciples to the Minghun Hall, looking at them in a daze."It's over, it's all over, how can I explain it to my ancestor! The third uncle and the others are all dead, and the things must have been lost." The patriarch stepped aside and came to the teleportation hall. He drowsily stepped into the teleportation array to go to the cave where his ancestors retreated. He stood at the door for a moment, considered the words, and stood solemnly after issuing the transmission note.More than an hour later, a hoarse voice came from inside, "Come in." The clan leader went in and knelt down in front of the ancestor, and then told the clan leader everything.After hearing this, the ancestor's eyes were like lightning, he stared at the patriarch closely and said, "What do you think? Is there anyone who is suspicious?" "How can I dare to tell the following about such a big matter? Only the two of us know about it.""Who could it be? According to what you just described, the life soul cards were all broken at the same moment, which proves that they all died in an instant. The person who can kill people so quickly is at least Taiyi monk or Daluo," the ancestor said.The patriarch Huo De raised his head and asked, "Fourteenth Master?" The ancestor remained calm for a moment, then shook his head and said, "It's not him. The things were originally sent to him. Sooner or later, he will need them. Besides, he fought with others in his early years and left behind hidden diseases. He has no hope of becoming rich in this life. That thing is of no use to him."Not big, and Yi'er is his most promising junior. He loves Yi'er so much that he can't do anything to her, so it's definitely not him!You send the Fourteenth a Star Realm Communication Talisman and ask him to check. The things must be found. You go down." The clan leader resigned and started to deal with the matter.Seventy years later, the Fourteenth Master of the Chen Family and several of his subordinates came to this airspace. They did not disturb Zhu Jiuyin and remained silent. After half a stick of incense, the Fourteenth Grandfather of the Chen Family secretly thought, "The Tianji Box is forged from Genxuan light iron. It is as light as a feather and extremely hard. It is invulnerable to all things and is absolutely not destroyed. It must have fallen into a certain star field. Look for it!"We must find it at all costs. The question is, where has it flown after seventy years?Which direction has it flown to?Fortunately, others have found it. Without my Chen family's unique methods, he still has a chance."Let's go, don't go back to the Moyang Star Territory, go directly to the ancestral land of the Ninghe Star Territory," the Fourteenth Ancestor said with a stamp of his feet.The sky box flew into deep space at the speed of lightning, colliding with small celestial bodies and small meteorites from time to time, constantly changing directions, and flew for seventy years.The Tianji box was pointed at Xiaoye's hometown of the Richen Continent by accident, and it flew towards Xiaoye with the light of fire.

距离小夜出生大约三百年前，在一片宇宙空间，一艘巨大的灵舰飞速的在空间穿梭，舰身上刻满了符文，符文明暗闪烁，流光溢彩，驶向末央星域。舰仓内，一位白袍儒生背对门外，正在向案前一位老者说话。“三叔，您老去歇一会，还有六十年左右就到末央星域了，快到的时候，我去叫您，这舰上，我安排弟子们盯着，我亲自坐镇舰首指挥”“嗯，不急，等你九叔和你六姑出关后，我再去休息，不亲自盯着，我不放心啊，前方就快到小陨石漂流带了，还有杂乱无章小彗星，这一片空间出没几支星际大盗，情况复杂，我有不好的预感，船舰上许些杂物不值几个钱，关键是天机匣，一定要安全送到末央星域，亲手交给十四祖手里，这可是老祖亲自再三交代的，如果有什么不测，你和你六姑带上天机匣，坐上小灵舰，啥也不要管，直接去末央星域，明白吗？”案前一灰衣老者盘膝而坐，怀里窝着一只黑猫。白衣儒生一楞，笑道“没那么严重吧，我们这可是玄玉号跨星舰，攻防一体，就是太乙期仙君来了，也能周旋一二，再说不是还有你们三位吗？如果真的有意外，请您老放心！我誓死扞卫我们家族的尊严，决不逃跑！”“糊涂！家族的目的是什么？是天机匣！此物万万不可丢失，这关系到我们家族能不能在末央星域打开局面，能不能站稳脚跟，你十四祖眼巴巴等着呢！”老者一瞪眼。“三叔，我知道轻重缓急，到时候如果有意外我一切听您安排，叔，这天机匣里装的是什么啊？老祖这么重视，”灰衣老者看了他一眼，沉思片刻，低声道“两个小世界，空间很大，里面的资源能让大罗金仙垂涎三尺”白衣男子一惊，“什么，不是只有一个小世界吗，另外一个小世界那来的？老祖咋考虑的？”老者叹口气道“一个是我们家的，另外一个是我们十万多年前豪夺崔家的，老祖亲自出的手，这事过后许多人有猜测是我们干的，现在十万年过去了，渐渐淡忘了，我们才拿出来，准备送到末央星域，此物我们家族打不开，老祖研究了几万年，如若强行打开，此物自毁。前一段时间，你十四祖传来消息，说是抓了个崔家后人，可以利用其精血能打开这小世界，老祖才让咱们送过去，老祖怀疑这个小世界里有本源之物，而且比我们的那个小世界还大。此事你知道就行，别往底下传了，知道的人越少越好。此事终了，你就别回宁合星域了，就在十四祖麾下修行，帮你十四祖处理一些俗事，十四祖非常看好你，亲自点了你名，否则，家祖里那么多精英，哪里能轮到你头上”白衣男子沉默了半响道“哪个崔家？是环玙星域微尘大陆的那个崔家吗？”“不是他们，还有谁？在道祖的品茶大会上，处处和我们陈家过不去，崔家老祖事事压我们老祖一头”老者恶狠狠的说道“也是他们崔家走霉运，他家老祖冲击大罗，没成功，身死道消，下面几脉旁系不服现任族长，接着数十位老怪份份出关，争权夺利，大打出手，死伤无数，血流成河，更有甚者是勾结外人，搞得族内乌烟瘴气。有一脉气愤不过，就偷偷地在内库里取出小世界，带上几名亲信，准备离开微尘大陆去其他界面发展，嘿嘿，结果，中了咱们老祖的圈套，老祖一个不留全部杀死了，当时十四祖也在场。得到了小世界，两位老祖开心的合不上嘴，直接隐身而去，辗转了几个星域才回来，就这都有不少有心人怀疑上咱们…”就在一老一少在仙舰上交谈时，远方的一块巨大陨石内部盘坐着三个人，一女两男，女修手里拿着一面镜子，镜面反射出的正是陈家玄玉号跨星舰。两男修其中有一个鬼修脸色蜡白，浑身上下时不时散出一缕黑色的尸气。“我敢确定舰上没有太乙金仙，我的三冥玄煞气在附近没有感应到大波动，也觉察不到太乙的气息，这一票，能干！金花仙子你就不能让小陨石群偏离一点轨道，让邱道友利用陨石布阵，困住舰船，我们也好从容动手”鬼修看着金花仙子手里的镜面问道。女修金花仙子看瞪了他一眼道“哪有那么容易，离空挪移镜只能搬动固定的物体，数量还不会太多，小陨石群可是高速移动的，要不，你试试？”鬼修嘿嘿一笑，转头道“邱英老哥，你说道说道”那名叫邱英的老头没理会二人，手里摆弄着几面小旗，半响说道“不急，前方数百万里位置有一群陨石带，旁边万里的地方是他们必经之路，他们绝对不会绕路，否则会被下方的巨大太阴星体引力拉过去，他们不敢赌。在过个三五天，我去哪里部阵，金花仙子你拿离空挪移镜提前在前面拉动一部分小陨石，我们也要注意，别被太阴星拉跑，嘿嘿，否则百余年都走不出来，我先走一步，三天后等我传讯”三天后，金花仙子也接到传讯走了，去挪移陨石了，就剩下鬼修不动声色的放出三冥玄煞气时时的感应着陈家灵舰，宇宙里没有空气，无法传播，全凭鬼修的玄煞气追踪感应。此门功法也简单，就是先释放一丝三冥玄煞气在舰船的必经之路上，随后本人在万里之外隐藏起来不停的释放玄煞气相互感应，问题是别人来不了，只有这鬼修的尸气变异之后炼成。鬼修不停的给二人传讯，金花仙子累的要死，不时的咽下丹丸恢复元气。“好了，静等上钩”邱老怪给二人传讯。远处的舰船上，白衣人正在安排。“各弟子注意，到自己岗位上去，各负其责，马上通过陨石群”舰船上白衣男子立在甲板上，大声呵斥着。陈家另外两个老怪也出关了，和白衣男修的三叔站在舰塔上，三人面色凝重。大船不停的扭动着身子，快速穿越陨石群。突然，两颗大陨石像见了鬼一般脱离轨道，闪电一般的砸向大船，舰体发出几道蓝光，船身摇晃着，舰上一阵惊叫，还好，陨石被击碎，危险解除。接下来半个月，总有陨石不停的砸向舰船，船上众人疲惫不堪，船上能量消耗严重，船身也有几处破碎。舰塔上三人都觉得蹊跷。“不对，退回去！”三叔道。刚要传令，四面八方冒出来七七四十九个巨大陨石，众多陨石之上绿光一闪，形成一个巨大黑洞吞噬大船。“好胆”“有贼人”“有埋伏”……舰上三人大惊，飞出舰塔各使手段打向陨石。

“桀桀，拿命来吧”星空中，一阵狂笑，一老者像个巨大的蝙蝠冲向三人。“杀”黑暗的空间，又有三颗陨石砸向舰船，前方阵旗形成的黑洞拼命地撕扯着大船，舰船剧烈的跳动，发出嘎嘎的巨响。“哄”的一声，陨石砸到了舰尾，鬼修化作一团黑雾乘机而入，船上发出一阵惨叫声。“轰隆隆”一声，舰身炸裂，火光冲天。“六妹，你和毅儿带上东西，快走！我和老九断后”打斗声、爆炸声、碰撞声乱成一团，虚空都扭曲了。数万里之外，一条巨蛇被火光干扰，它数千年前被太阴星引力无意拉到这里，昏昏沉沉的沉睡，它没被惊醒，它无意识的、无目标尾巴一摆向这片打斗区域扫来，顿时，星空撕裂，数万里的长尾像一道闪电甩了过来，空中留下一片残影。“不”“天哪”“是烛九阴”“跑啊”片刻后，万里区域静悄悄，什么都没有了，只有一个二尺长，半尺宽的匣子向闪电一般，拉着火光，飞往黑暗的太空，不知所终，怪蛇又盘成一团。与此同时，遥远的宁合星域陈家祖地安放着魂牌殿堂，一阵噼里啪啦，几百个魂牌破碎，其中有三个是老祖级别的，看守命魂殿的弟子大吃一惊，头发都炸起来了，两腿直哆嗦，觉得小腿肚子都扭到前面去了，他连滚带爬出了门直奔族长洞府。陈族长坐在案几前，在看账本，满脸都是笑容，嘿嘿！收成不错嘛！听见有弟子叩门，叫进来问道“慌慌张张，成何体统！”弟子结结巴巴说道“有几百个族人全部身亡，其中包括三位叔祖”。老族长听的心惊肉跳，刚要起身只觉得两眼一黑，“扑通”又坐在榻上。少许又挣扎起来，跟随后辈弟子来到命魂殿，看的两眼直发呆。“完了，全完了，怎么给老祖交代啊！三叔祖他们全死了，东西肯定丢了。”族长一闪身，来到传送殿，昏昏沉沉的踏进传送阵去往老祖宗闭关的洞府，他在门口站立片刻，斟酌了一下词语，发出传音符后就肃穆而立。一个多时辰后，里面传来沙哑的声音“进来吧”族长进去后“扑通”一下跪在老祖面前，然后一五一十的告诉老族。老祖听罢两眼如电，紧紧的盯着族长说道“你怎么看，有怀疑对象吗？”“这么大的事，我哪里敢给下面说，就我们两人知道”。“会是谁呢？据你刚才的描述，命魂牌都是同一瞬间破碎，证明他们都是死在刹那间，能够如此之快的杀人起码是太乙修士或者是大罗”老祖说道。族长霍的一抬头道“十四爷？”老祖不动神色，半响，摇摇头道“不是他，东西本来就是给他送去的，迟早他要用到，再说，他早年跟人争斗，留下了暗疾，此生无望大罗，那东西对他用处不大，还有，毅儿是他最看好的后辈，他对毅儿疼爱有加，他下不去手，所以绝不是他！你给老十四发个夸星域传讯符，让他查查，东西一定要找回来，你下去吧”族长告退，着手办理此事。七十年后，陈家十四爷和几个属下来到这片空域，没有惊动烛九阴，默默无语，半柱香时间过后，陈家十四祖心中暗道“天机匣以艮玄轻铁锻造而成，轻如鸿毛，坚硬无比，万物不侵，绝对没有毁掉，肯定是落往某片星域，找！不惜一切代价，一定要找到，问题是七十年过去了，它飞到哪里了？它向哪个方位飞去了？欣慰的是他人得到，没我陈家独特手法，他也打不开，还有机会。”“走，不回末央星域了，直接回宁合星域祖地”十四祖一跺脚说道。天机匣以闪电的速度，飞向深空，中途不时的碰撞小天体、小陨石，不停地变换着方向，飞行了七十年后。天机匣好巧不巧的方位对准小夜家乡裂尘大陆，拉着火光飞奔而来。
